subject: Error:  Infeasible point, no further tests

messages.author: fb1c256ee304f750
messages.subject: Error:  Infeasible point, no further tests
parts:
Hello!

I am a graduate student at San Diego State University and I am running BioGeoBEARS on my dataset of 80 taxa in 9 areas with a max_range_size of 6.  I have been successful in getting all programs but  BAYAREALIKE+J to run.

 The error I get is as follows:

 Calculation of likelihood on initial parameters: successful.

 Now starting Maximum Likelihood (ML) parameter optimization with optimx()...

 Maximizing -- use negfn and neggr

 Error in optimx.check(par, optcfg$ufn, optcfg$ugr, optcfg$uhess, lower,  :

  Infeasible point, no further tests

 

I have tried to adjust the max and min values of d, e, and j, but have had little luck is fixing the problem. I am not quite sure what the next step should be.

Thank you very much for your time,

Makenzie Mabry
